papers.title: When Reasoning Is Not Enough: Proactive Inquiry for Cross-Modal Safety in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can act unsafely when individually benign images and texts are interpreted jointly. Beyond implicit reasoning risk, where reasoning drifts toward harm, we identify intent-level risk, where cross-modal ambiguity silently commits the model to a hazardous premise that path-level optimization alone cannot correct. We propose SAFE-PRO, which uses a Risk-Conditioned Uncertainty (RCU) signal, combining predictive entropy with a learned cross-modal risk score, to decide when to ask safety-grounded clarifying questions and where to apply path optimization, under a reward that prioritizes safety and penalizes over-refusal. We also build SSUI-Dialog, a multimodal multi-turn dataset with dual-intent supervision, and theoretically analyze gradient variance and unsafe-completion risk under RCU. Across seven benchmarks and two base MLLMs, SAFE-PRO consistently improves safety over SRPO, roughly halves its over-refusal, and surpasses GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet in average single-turn safety.

summary.takeaway: 提出SAFE-PRO，利用风险条件不确定性（RCU）信号判断何时提出安全澄清问题、何处进行路径优化，以应对多模态大模型中的意图级跨模态安全风险。
summary.methods: 将预测熵与学习到的跨模态风险分数结合构成RCU信号；在优先安全并惩罚过度拒答的奖励下训练；构建带双意图监督的多模态多轮数据集SSUI-Dialog；并在七个基准和两个基座MLLM上评估。
summary.relevance: 直接关联多模态学习、跨模态理解与对齐安全，涉及MLLM的对齐与安全推理，也与检索增强与对齐主题中的安全对齐相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体数值增益、基准名称细节与消融结果；跨模态风险分数的学习方式和额外标注成本未说明。

papers.title: Retrofitting Recurrent Vision-Language Models from Pretrained Backbones
papers.abstract: Recent work shows that depth recurrence can be retrofitted into pretrained language models. In this work, we adapt this paradigm for visual understanding, using depth recurrence to reduce the parameter footprint of a pretrained vision-language model (VLM). To this end, we prune layers from the language backbone of the VLM and loop over a subset of the remaining layers. At each step of the loop, a linear adapter merges the block's output with the token representations from the preceding layers and projects the fused representation back into the block. As the pruning impacts the original model performance, we propose a three-stage recovery training: first, we leverage a language-only pretraining to recover the performance of the language backbone, followed by an alignment of the vision-language projector, and a full fine-tuning of the model via visual instruction tuning. In the first and the last stage, we distill the outputs of the pretrained non-recurrent model into the recurrent model, which further improves the recovery. We evaluate the proposed approach on the TinyLLaVA-1.4B backbone without introducing any new vision-language data during retrofitting. Our experiments demonstrate that the retrofitted recurrent model outperforms the unpruned baseline trained with the same recovery data while storing 23.3% fewer language parameters. We further show that the proposed retrofitting recurrence outperforms the setup of converting a recurrent LM into a VLM on the same data. Additionally, our ablations show how design choices, such as the adapter between recurrences and a larger recurrent block, lead to the improved performance of our approach. Finally, we find that our proposed model gains on reasoning-oriented benchmarks, whereas its performance on basic visual understanding benchmarks remains on par with the baseline.

summary.takeaway: 将深度循环改造引入预训练视觉语言模型，通过剪枝语言骨干并对剩余层循环复用，在减少语言参数的同时保持或提升视觉理解性能。
summary.methods: 从VLM语言骨干中剪枝层并对子集层做循环；每步用线性适配器融合块输出与前面token表示；采用三阶段恢复训练（语言预训练恢复、视觉-语言投影器对齐、视觉指令微调全量微调），首末阶段对非循环预训练模型做蒸馏；在TinyLLaVA-1.4B上评估，未引入新视觉语言数据。
summary.relevance: 关联多模态学习与大语言模型效率，涉及预训练与跨模态理解，属于模型压缩与持续适配方向。
summary.caveat: 仅在单一基座TinyLLaVA-1.4B上验证；摘要称存储语言参数减少23.3%，但未报告计算开销或更大模型上的泛化性。

papers.title: Progress Reward Model for Reinforcement Learning via Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Traditional reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms face significant limitations in handling long-term tasks with sparse rewards. Recent advancements have leveraged large language models (LLMs) to enhance RL by utilizing their world knowledge for task planning and reward generation. However, planning-based approaches often depend on pre-defined skill libraries and fail to optimize low-level control policies, while reward-based methods require extensive human feedback or exhaustive searching due to the complexity of tasks. In this paper, we propose the Progress Reward Model for RL (PRM4RL), a novel framework that integrates task planning and dense reward to enhance RL. For high-level planning, a complex task is decomposed into a series of simple manageable subtasks, with a subtask-oriented, fine-grained progress function designed to monitor task execution progress. For low-level reward generation, inspired by potential-based reward shaping, we use the progress function to construct a Progress Reward Model (PRM), providing theoretically grounded optimality and convergence guarantees, thereby enabling effective policy optimization. Experimental results on robotics control tasks demonstrate that our approach outperforms both LLM-based planning and reward methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance. Code is available at https://github.com/deng-ai-lab/PRM4RL.

summary.takeaway: 提出PRM4RL，将LLM任务规划与基于势函数的稠密进度奖励结合，缓解长时稀疏奖励强化学习中的优化困难。
summary.methods: 用LLM将复杂任务分解为子任务并设计子任务级细粒度进度函数；受potential-based reward shaping启发构造Progress Reward Model，提供理论上的最优性与收敛保证；在机器人控制任务上实验。
summary.relevance: 关联强化学习与大语言模型用于奖励生成和任务规划，属于LLM增强RL及对齐/决策方向。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称在机器人控制任务上达到SOTA，未列出具体任务、基线名称或数值；对LLM规划错误和奖励模型偏差的鲁棒性未讨论。

papers.title: CART: Compatible Routing for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance through instruction tuning, yet real-world applications often require them to continually acquire new capabilities from sequential tasks, i.e., Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT). In typical MLLMs, a projector is employed to align visual representations with the language model. However, existing methods primarily protect the language model from forgetting while continuously updating the projector across tasks. Such asymmetric adaptation can cause substantial representation drift in the projector, increasing the mismatch between the projector and language model and consequently exacerbating catastrophic forgetting. To address this issue, we propose Compatible Routing (CART), which explicitly coordinates the adaptation of the projector and language model. Specifically, CART maintains task-specific experts for both modules and combines them through weighted mixtures. CART jointly infers their weights by considering both expert relevance and cross-module compatibility, thereby promoting coordinated adaptation between the two modules. To further control model growth, we introduce relevance-guided expert consolidation, which merges experts exhibiting similar relevance profiles across samples within each module. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CART achieves state-of-the-art performance.

summary.takeaway: 针对多模态持续指令微调中投影器与语言模型非对称更新导致的表征漂移，提出兼容路由CART协同适配两个模块以减少灾难性遗忘。
summary.methods: 为投影器和语言模型分别维护任务特定专家并做加权混合；联合考虑专家相关性与跨模块兼容性推断权重；引入相关性引导的专家合并以控制模型增长；在MCIT设置下做大量实验。
summary.relevance: 直接关联多模态学习、持续学习与持续适应，也涉及MLLM指令微调与对齐。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体基准、数据集名称与数值结果；专家数量增长和合并阈值等设计细节未展开。

papers.title: Skill-Decoupled On-Policy Expert Distillation for Unified Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can elicit specialized visual capabilities in vision-language models (VLMs), yet jointly optimizing heterogeneous objectives often introduces cross-capability gradient conflicts. Training experts independently mitigates this interference, but direct reward optimization may entangle specialized knowledge with reward-hacking biases. This paper proposes Skill-Decoupled On-Policy Expert Distillation (SCOPED), which trains capability-specific experts and extracts explicit skills through reward-guided reflection. During on-policy distillation, these skills guide expert supervision while remaining unavailable to the unified student, encouraging it to internalize procedural knowledge without explicit skills at inference time. Across eight multimodal benchmarks, SCOPED consistently outperforms the backbone and mixed-capability RL, demonstrating the effectiveness of skill-decoupled on-policy expert distillation for integrating independently acquired capabilities. Further analyses reveal interference during joint capability optimization and suggest that skill augmentation promotes more consistent expert trajectories, greater attention to task-relevant visual evidence, and better preservation of specialized expertise in the unified student. All code and data are available at https://github.com/NEUIR/SCOPED.

summary.takeaway: 提出SCOPED，先训练能力特定专家，再通过奖励引导反思提取显式技能，并在on-policy蒸馏中用于指导统一学生模型，以缓解多能力联合优化中的梯度冲突。
summary.methods: 分别训练能力特定专家；通过奖励引导反思提取显式技能；on-policy蒸馏时用技能指导专家监督，但推理时学生模型不直接获得技能；在八个多模态基准上评估并做分析。
summary.relevance: 关联强化学习、多模态学习与跨模态理解，涉及VLM能力整合和对齐训练。
summary.caveat: 摘要给出八基准上优于骨干和混合能力RL的结论，但未列出基准名称和具体数值；技能提取质量与奖励黑客风险仅被提及为动机，未给出量化限制。

papers.title: DK-VLM: Geometry as Position for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language models still struggle to understand 3D spatial relations across views and update spatial judgments as the observer moves. A common approach fuses 3D reconstruction features into visual tokens, but aligning these features with pretrained semantic representations remains challenging under limited spatial supervision. We propose DK-VLM with Dual-Kernel Attention, which computes attention from both a visual token's input position and its geometric position in the scene. A semantic kernel retains the pretrained model's native attention and positional encoding, while a separate geometric kernel uses estimated 3D points and camera poses to directly modulate attention through point displacements and relative view transformations. Then, a learned gate fuses their outputs. Geometry thus enters attention as position rather than as fused reconstruction features. We further introduce Reference-Frame Composition (RC) supervision to train the model to update its reference frame across successive judgments. It provides stepwise turn and heading targets derived from verified single-step annotations. Among the compared methods, DK-VLM-8B achieves the highest average score across six spatial benchmarks and the highest overall scores on VSI-Bench (74.33) and ReVSI-32 (58.28). RC supervision further improves multi-step spatial reasoning, while the full model preserves general video understanding. Project page: https://sumuru789.github.io/DK-VLM-website/.

summary.takeaway: 提出DK-VLM，用双核注意力把几何位置直接引入注意力调制，并配合参考系组合监督，提升VLM跨视角三维空间推理与参考系更新能力。
summary.methods: 设计语义核保留预训练注意力和位置编码，几何核利用估计的3D点和相机位姿通过点位移与相对视角变换调制注意力，再用学习门融合；引入Reference-Frame Composition监督，由已验证单步标注派生逐步转向和朝向目标；在六个空间基准及VSI-Bench、ReVSI-32上评估。
summary.relevance: 关联多模态学习、跨模态理解与空间推理，涉及预训练VLM的几何理解增强。
summary.caveat: 依赖估计的3D点和相机位姿，摘要未说明这些估计误差的影响；仅在8B规模报告主要结果，通用视频理解仅称保持，未给具体数值。

papers.title: Librarian Agents: Training LLMs to Curate Long-Context Workspaces that Anticipate Future Queries
papers.abstract: Reasoning over long document contexts remains a challenge for large language models (LLMs). Standard retrieval methods are inherently reactive, bottlenecking agents with complex, cross-document reasoning at inference time, while precomputed structures like knowledge graphs often fall short because they rely on rigid heuristics. Instead, can we allow agents to perform anticipatory directed curation: learning to proactively reorganize unstructured corpora prior to inference to efficiently serve diverse future queries. We build on a key asymmetry in modern agentic harnesses (e.g., Claude Code): while LLM agents are adept at navigating existing filesystems to solve an immediate task, they are rarely trained to construct reusable workspaces for future use. To instantiate this capability, we introduce Librarian Agents, a framework in which a builder agent transforms raw documents into a hierarchical filesystem of synthetic files and reference links, which forms a workspace tailored for a downstream answering agent. We formulate workspace construction as a Markov decision process and optimize the builder policy via reinforcement learning to directly maximize downstream answering accuracy. Empirically, Librarian Agents outperforms the strongest retrieval and precomputation baselines by 33 percentage points on BrowseComp-Plus, amortizes upfront construction costs across repeated queries, and generalizes zero-shot to unseen domains on BRIGHT with a 31-point average accuracy improvement.

summary.takeaway: 提出Librarian Agents，训练构建者智能体在推理前主动将原始文档重组为分层文件系统工作区，以服务未来多样化查询，而非被动检索。
summary.methods: 将工作区构建建模为马尔可夫决策过程，用强化学习优化构建者策略以直接最大化下游回答准确率；构建者生成合成文件与引用链接组成工作区，供下游回答智能体使用；在BrowseComp-Plus和BRIGHT上评估。
summary.relevance: 直接关联检索增强与对齐、大语言模型智能体，也涉及知识图谱式预计算结构的替代方案。
summary.caveat: 摘要称在BrowseComp-Plus上比最强检索/预计算基线高33个百分点、BRIGHT零样本平均提升31点，但未说明基线具体构成与构建成本；工作区构建的前期开销只提到可摊销，未给量化。

papers.title: Functional Subnetwork Localization for Efficient Continual Learning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Biological intelligence continually adapts to new information while retaining prior skills through localized plasticity. In contrast, continual learning in large language models (LLMs) remains vulnerable to catastrophic forgetting. A promising direction is to identify functionally specialized subnetworks within LLMs that enable targeted and resource-efficient adaptation. Using gradient-attribution profiling, we localize cognition-associated functional subnetworks exhibiting extremely low mutual overlap. Building on this finding, we propose Function-isolated Memory-Efficient Optimization (CiMEO), a continual learning framework that routes each training example to its corresponding functional subnetwork, restricting parameter updates and optimizer states to selected regions. Across 1.4 million sequential instructions, CiMEO achieves the highest average performance among the compared methods on five generative benchmarks spanning programming, examination-style tasks, and mathematical reasoning, while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Subspace-overlap and principal-angle analyses further indicate that localized updates help preserve pre-trained representations, highlighting functional subnetwork localization as a practical approach to efficient and stable continual learning in LLMs.

summary.takeaway: 通过梯度归因定位LLM中互重叠极低的功能子网络，并提出CiMEO将持续学习样本路由到对应功能子网络，以限制参数和优化器状态更新来缓解灾难性遗忘。
summary.methods: 用梯度归因剖析定位认知相关功能子网络；提出Function-isolated Memory-Efficient Optimization，将每个训练样本路由到相应子网络并只更新选中区域；在140万条顺序指令和五个生成基准上评估，并做子空间重叠与主角度分析。
summary.relevance: 直接关联大语言模型持续学习与持续适应，涉及高效微调和预训练表征保护。
summary.caveat: 摘要只给出平均性能最高和缓解遗忘的定性结论，未列具体基准名称与数值；功能子网络的定位是否跨模型稳定未说明。

papers.title: MemComposer: Learning to Assemble Memories for LLM Agents via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Agent memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to reuse past experiences without updating their parameters. However, semantic similarity alone does not guarantee memory usefulness: downstream performance depends on how memories are selected and presented to the agent. We propose MemComposer, a memory composer that jointly examines the current query and retrieved candidates to decide which experiences to include, how many to select, and how to order them. We train the composer using Experience Policy Optimization (ExPO), a GRPO-based framework that evaluates assembled memory contexts through complete agent interactions and uses task-success feedback to optimize the assembly policy. Across three $τ^2$-bench domains with two frozen executors, MemComposer outperforms the strongest baseline for each executor while reducing average memory-token usage by 16.9% and 4.9%, respectively. The learned policy also transfers to unseen domains, executors, and memory banks, and benefits from memories generated by stronger models without further training. These results demonstrate the value of learning query-specific memory assembly using downstream task feedback.

summary.takeaway: MemComposer 学习在给定查询时如何选择、选取数量与排序检索到的记忆片段，并用下游任务成功反馈优化这一组合策略。
summary.methods: 提出基于 GRPO 的 Experience Policy Optimization，通过完整 agent 交互评估组装后的记忆上下文；在 τ²-bench 三个域、两种冻结执行器上评测。
summary.relevance: 直接关联大语言模型 agent 的记忆复用与检索增强，并将强化学习用于记忆选择与呈现。
summary.caveat: 摘要只给出相对基线的记忆 token 节省比例与跨域迁移结论，未披露绝对性能、基准规模或训练成本细节。

papers.title: Perception or Reasoning? Diagnosing and Tackling Reinforcement Learning Bottlenecks in VLMs
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning has brought strong gains to language model reasoning, but its improvements on visual tasks remain less consistent. One difficulty is that visual task failures can arise from different sources: the same benchmark may be limited by perception for one model and by reasoning for another. We introduce Perception and Reasoning Attribution (PARA), which measures the remaining perceptual and reasoning headroom of each model--benchmark pair by comparing how many current errors are recovered with more accurate visual information versus a stronger reasoner. Across 4 vision-language models and 17 multimodal benchmarks, PARA broadly agrees with the expected characteristics of existing benchmarks while revealing substantial model-specific variation. More importantly, it shows that RL gains become smaller as perceptual headroom increases, but larger when reasoning explains more of the recoverable errors, suggesting that current RL exploits reasoning headroom more effectively than perceptual headroom. Motivated by this gap, we analyze how existing RL objectives affect visual perception and find that reward- and token-level signals influence visual attention only indirectly. We therefore propose GRAD, a group-relative attention distillation objective that uses the best rollout in each group to directly guide the visual attention of weaker rollouts. GRAD consistently improves performance across two model scales and seven benchmarks, and further complements existing RL methods.

summary.takeaway: 提出 PARA 诊断每个模型—基准组合的感知与推理剩余空间，指出 RL 更多利用推理余量而非感知余量，并提出 GRAD 直接蒸馏视觉注意力。
summary.methods: 在 4 个视觉语言模型与 17 个多模态基准上，通过更准视觉信息与更强推理器比较错误可恢复量；提出组相对注意力蒸馏目标 GRAD。
summary.relevance: 关联多模态模型强化学习后训练，分析 RL 瓶颈来源并改进视觉感知。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出 GRAD 的具体提升数值、模型规模细节，也未说明 PARA 估计的因果解释边界。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning-driven Diffusion Models: Language, Vision, and Beyond
papers.abstract: Diffusion models (DMs) have steadily demonstrated outstanding performance in high-fidelity, controllable generation across diverse scenarios, following the "pretraining-finetuning" paradigm established in LLMs. Despite these advances, conventional DMs still face critical limitations in sophisticated reasoning, autonomous exploration of generation pathways, and adaptability to complex, human-aligned objectives. Inspired by RLHF's success in LLMs, RL has recently emerged as a pivotal post-training mechanism to iteratively refine DMs through reward-driven trajectory optimization. This paper presents the first comprehensive review of RL-driven DMs and an empirical analysis of how RL reshapes the diffusion process towards experience-centric, goal-directed generation. We propose a novel technical panorama elucidating RL's multifaceted roles in diffusion-based language, multimodal, robotic, and scientific models, with a granular focus on diffusion trajectory optimization and reward engineering. Through extensive experiments on multiple task-specific benchmarks, we systematically evaluate representative methods to intuitively highlight the advantages of different RL post-training strategies. Furthermore, we reveal and dissect three crucial bottlenecks that currently hinder the real-world deployment of RL-driven DMs: reward design fragility, exploration-exploitation trade-off in high-dimensional generation spaces, and training instability under sparse rewards. Based on these perspectives, we provide a principled roadmap for the integration of RL into DMs and outline promising future research directions for robust, interpretable RL-diffusion systems. We also construct a public repository to continuously track the latest developments in this rapidly evolving field: https://github.com/MAIR-Lab-HUST/Awesome-RL-for-Diffusion-Models.

summary.takeaway: 综述强化学习驱动的扩散模型，提出技术全景并实证分析 RL 如何重塑扩散生成过程，同时归纳三个部署瓶颈。
summary.methods: 文献综述加多任务基准实验，覆盖语言、多模态、机器人与科学模型，聚焦扩散轨迹优化与奖励工程。
summary.relevance: 关联强化学习后训练、奖励学习与生成模型预训练—微调范式。
summary.caveat: 作为综述，摘要未说明实验选择标准与覆盖完整性；瓶颈结论为作者归纳，缺少统一量化元分析。

papers.title: Constrained Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning in Imagination
papers.abstract: Predicting cost in a multi-agent world model moves most constrained policy updates into imagination: the stronger model-free baseline needs $10$ to $20$ times CA-MAMBA's interactions on the median SMAC configuration, and CA-MAMBA earns $2.8$ to $12$ times the baselines' MAMuJoCo reward at equal budget. In controlled tests on one task per benchmark, pricing the model's cost advantages at parity more than halves a cost-blind learner's cost and meets a tight continuous-control limit the learned multiplier misses, suggesting the model's cost estimates are not the bottleneck.

summary.takeaway: 在多智能体世界模型中预测代价，可将大部分约束策略更新移到想象中进行，从而显著减少交互并提升奖励。
summary.methods: 提出 CA-MAMBA；在 SMAC 与 MAMuJoCo 上与无模型基线比较交互次数与等预算奖励，并进行单任务控制实验。
summary.relevance: 直接关联约束多智能体强化学习与基于模型的策略学习。
summary.caveat: 交互与奖励倍数来自摘要报告的中位配置和等预算设置；控制实验仅每基准一个任务，泛化性有限。

papers.title: Visual Sanad: Auditing Vision-Language Models for False Acceptance of Qur'anic Citations
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to interpret religious, educational, and culturally sensitive visual content, yet their reliability on citation verification remains underexplored. We introduce Visual Sanad, a controlled benchmark for testing whether VLMs falsely accept incorrect Qur'anic verse attributions when the same quote-reference pair is rendered under different visual framings. The benchmark contains 2,400 rendered images built from 100 English Qur'an verses, four factual states per verse, and six visual conditions ranging from plain text to decorative and authority-framed layouts. All quote-reference pairs were source-checked and human-audited before rendering. Across 24 full model-prompt runs, we observe a sharp capability split. Proprietary API-served VLMs range from near-perfect citation verification to moderate false acceptance, whereas recent open-weight VLMs often show weak discrimination and default to VALID on most images. De-biased prompting can reduce false acceptance, but often by shifting the decision threshold toward INVALID rather than by producing strong citation discrimination. Visual Sanad therefore exposes a culturally grounded multimodal factuality failure: fluent VLMs may treat displayed religious citations as self-authenticating unless they have strong citation-verification ability.

summary.takeaway: Visual Sanad 揭示视觉语言模型在古兰经引文归属核验上存在错误接受，且不同视觉呈现会引发系统性差异。
summary.methods: 构建 2,400 张渲染图像基准，基于 100 条英文经文、四种事实状态与六种视觉条件，经来源核对与人工审计；测试 24 组模型—提示运行。
summary.relevance: 关联多模态事实性、跨模态理解与文化敏感内容审计。
summary.caveat: 仅覆盖古兰经英文引文与特定渲染条件；去偏提示多改变判定阈值而非提升判别力，结论不宜外推到其他宗教或语言。

papers.title: MYOPIA: Understanding the Limits of Tree-Based Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Decision trees can make vision-language model (VLM) classification interpretable by replacing a single prediction with a sequence of root-to-leaf questions. However, the accuracy cost of this greedy, non-backtracking procedure remains unclear. We introduce \textbf{MYOPIA}, a benchmark comprising four LLM-generated, human-refined decision trees for GTSRB, MNIST, CIFAR-10, and MSCOCO, together with matched prompts, diagnostic protocols, and an evaluation harness. Across GPT-4o, Qwen-VL Max, and LLaMA-3.2 11B Vision, tree traversal underperforms zero-shot prompting in all 12 dataset--model pairs; paired bootstrap analyses consistently favor zero-shot. Our diagnostics characterize interacting failure modes associated with this gap. Models often recall tree-encoded class attributes more accurately than they ground the same attributes in images: the mean label--image accuracy gaps are 9.5, 13.8, and 12.6 points for GPT-4o, Qwen-VL Max, and LLaMA, respectively. Incorrect local decisions then irreversibly exclude the correct class, while answer extraction introduces additional model-dependent loss. A node-level audit of the four trees finds that split entropy is weakly but consistently associated with lower node accuracy, whereas depth, branching factor, and within-node grounding differences are less stable. \textbf{MYOPIA} therefore provides a framework for diagnosing hierarchical visual classification and motivates testing tree designs that prioritize perceptual answerability and recovery from early errors. Code is available at https://github.com/islammesabah/VLM_Classification.

summary.takeaway: MYOPIA 显示树式问答遍历在全部 12 个数据集—模型组合中不如零样本提示，并诊断出属性回忆强于图像 grounding、早期错误不可恢复等失败模式。
summary.methods: 为 GTSRB、MNIST、CIFAR-10、MSCOCO 构建四棵 LLM 生成并经人工精修的决策树，配套提示与评测框架；在 GPT-4o、Qwen-VL Max、LLaMA-3.2 11B Vision 上做配对 bootstrap 分析与节点级审计。
summary.relevance: 关联视觉语言模型的分层视觉分类、可解释推理与跨模态 grounding。
summary.caveat: 结论限于贪心非回溯树遍历与所选四个数据集、三个模型；摘要未验证可回溯或感知优先树设计能否缩小差距。

papers.title: ZoomCap: Evidence-Routed Visual Zooming for Recoverable Visual Information Transfer
papers.abstract: Detailed captions transfer visual information into vision-language model supervision, but quality is easily conflated with length: long single-pass outputs still miss small objects, text, and spatial relations or promote uncertain observations into confident claims. We formulate fine-grained captioning as recoverable visual information transfer, in which a teacher acquires missing evidence under a finite observation budget and converts it into reusable supervision. ZoomCap uses a draft caption to route conditional knowledge retrieval, OCR-sensitive reading, coverage-gap recovery, and adaptive visual zooming, allocating deeper crops only to the most complex eligible region, deriving spatial relations from grounded geometry, and fusing non-duplicate evidence. We also introduce FactCycle, which scores caption-derived atomic claims on two blind anchors--source image (truthfulness) and reconstruction (realizability)--separating fabrication from generator loss claim by claim; human and multi-judge comparisons complement this fact-level view. Against Qwen3.5-397B-A17B captions, ZoomCap achieves an 81.9% human tie-adjusted preference score with a teacher over 10x smaller, and FactCycle counts 52.4 transferred claims per image vs. 31.5 for ScaleCap. The evidence also transfers: in continual pre-training, ZoomCap-450K improves the 11-benchmark average by 1.31-2.38 points over the strongest competing corpus and Ling-Tiny-VL-v3 gains 1.4 points on a production document/OCR monitor suite (1.5 on perception) at 60B tokens; in medical pre-training, 2.64M ZoomCap-captioned images improve five VQA benchmarks by 3.04 points (vs. 1.76 for same-image Gemini-3.1-Pro captions).

summary.takeaway: ZoomCap 将细粒度 captioning 建模为可恢复的视觉信息传递，用草稿 caption 路由检索、OCR 阅读、覆盖缺口恢复与自适应缩放；FactCycle 以真实性与可重建性分解核验原子声明。
summary.methods: 教师模型在有限观察预算下按证据路由深层裁剪，融合非重复证据；FactCycle 用源图与重建两个盲锚点评分声明；在继续预训练与医学预训练中评估迁移。
summary.relevance: 关联多模态监督数据构建、检索增强、持续预训练与跨模态信息传递。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告的是相对特定竞争语料与模型的提升；FactCycle 依赖声明分解与重建质量，教师规模与观察预算设置可能影响可迁移性。

papers.title: Learning to Steer LLM Agents and Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents and multi-agent systems increasingly tackle complex tasks through long-horizon tool use and inter-agent collaboration. However, these systems are prone to deviating from the overall goal as execution unfolds, which wastes execution resources and leads to undesired outcomes, a failure termed goal drift. In this work, we propose a steering agent that supervises execution on the fly and steers the system back on track when drift occurs. The steering agent observes the execution context, deciding when to intervene with a low-cost fast path and how to intervene with a high-cost slow path. To unlock its steering intelligence, the ability to assess goal drift and generate effective interventions, we jointly train the two paths with reinforcement learning, combining a pairwise ranking objective with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). Experiments on information-seeking search tasks show that the steering agent provides effective supervision for both single-agent and multi-agent systems, improving their performance and efficiency. The learned steering intelligence generalizes to out-of-domain tasks, transfers to unseen executors, and supports controllable intervention frequency without retraining.

summary.takeaway: 提出监督执行过程的 steering agent，用低成本快速路径决定何时干预、高成本慢速路径决定如何干预，以缓解 LLM 单/多智能体的目标漂移。
summary.methods: 联合训练两条路径，结合成对排序目标与 GRPO；在信息检索式搜索任务上评估单智能体与多智能体系统。
summary.relevance: 直接关联大语言模型 agent 与多智能体系统的强化学习控制。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告信息搜寻任务上的改进，未给出数值；干预频率可控与跨执行器迁移的边界条件未详述。

papers.title: Towards Continual Learning: Mitigating Forgetting With Subspace Tuning
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) acquire new skills through fine-tuning, but it can destroy capabilities they already have: catastrophic forgetting remains a central obstacle to continual learning in LLMs. Recent works connect forgetting to how far, and along which directions, fine-tuning moves the weights. On-policy methods such as reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation avoid updating the principal singular directions of weight matrices and thus forget less. In contrast, SFT concentrates updates along these directions and is susceptible to catastrophic forgetting. In this work, we introduce Subspace Tuning (SST), which restricts each weight update to the bottom singular subspace, eliminating changes along the principal directions. SST is optimizer-agnostic and composes well with fine-tuning recipes including SFT and self-distillation. SST combines tight subspace protection, dense gradient estimation, and a simple refresh mechanism, enabling stronger learning than prior orthogonal fine-tuning methods. With these mechanisms, protecting as much as 99\% of the weight subspace substantially improves retention while preserving strong target-task performance. This behavior strengthens with model and data size and nearly eliminates forgetting in the large-model regime. SST also keeps the model close to its base distribution, inducing $2$--$4\times$ less KL drift than the baseline recipes. Overall, SST advances the learning--forgetting Pareto frontier, making it a practical default for fine-tuning pre-trained language models.

summary.takeaway: 提出 Subspace Tuning (SST)，将每次权重更新限制在权重矩阵的底部奇异子空间，避免改动主奇异方向，从而在微调中显著缓解灾难性遗忘。
summary.methods: 在 SFT 与自蒸馏等微调流程中结合紧密子空间保护、稠密梯度估计和简单刷新机制；与优化器无关，可与常见微调配方组合。
summary.relevance: 直接对应大语言模型持续学习与灾难性遗忘问题，并与论文中提到的强化学习、on-policy 蒸馏等避免主方向更新的思路形成关联。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出保护比例、遗忘缓解和 KL 漂移的定性/相对描述，未提供具体数据集、基线设置与完整实验细节；需查阅原文核实。

papers.title: Loud and Clear: Making Visual Evidence Count in Multimodal Document RAG
papers.abstract: Multimodal document retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has focused largely on retrieval, yet its answers depend on how well a vision-language model reads the retrieved pages. We find that evidence in retrieved pages remains underused even when the correct pages are retrieved. On SciEGQA oracle pages, five prior methods give the generator 0.7K to 2.7K visual tokens per query on average under a common image processor, yet raising the page-only budget from 1K to 32K improves accuracy by 15.22 points. At a fixed 16K budget, adding ground-truth crops improves accuracy by 3.75 points over page-only input. We study what the generator needs from retrieved pages through two requirements: Loud, making full use of visual token capacity, and Clear, refining the page so that its evidence becomes prominent. For Loud, increasing either the visual token budget or visual fidelity, the image resolution those tokens preserve, improves accuracy with the other held fixed, and full-page scaling outperforms repetition and tiling at matched budgets. For Clear, suppressing surrounding content improves accuracy without enlarging selected regions, and adding OCR of these regions to page images outperforms either input alone. We implement both as Loud and Clear (LoC), which combines higher-resolution pages with OCR from query-relevant regions without ground-truth annotations or additional training. LoC outperforms eight prior methods on SciEGQA, ViDoRe-v3, and MMLongBench-Doc, improving over the strongest, ColQwen3, by 8.88, 3.09, and 4.22 points with the same retriever and generator. It also outperforms its page-only variant under the same visual token budget. These results locate a bottleneck beyond retrieval: how the retrieved pages are given to the generator.

summary.takeaway: 指出多模态文档 RAG 的瓶颈不只在检索，还在于生成器如何使用检索到的页面；提出 LoC，通过高分辨率页面与查询相关区域 OCR 提升视觉证据利用率。
summary.methods: 在 SciEGQA 等基准上分析视觉 token 预算与图像保真度的影响；LoC 组合更高分辨率页面图像与查询相关区域的 OCR 文本，无需真值标注或额外训练。
summary.relevance: 属于多模态文档检索增强生成，关注检索结果如何被视觉语言模型有效读取，契合检索增强与跨模态理解主题。
summary.caveat: 摘要主要报告特定基准上的提升，未说明方法在更广泛文档类型或低资源场景下的泛化；OCR 依赖也带来额外处理成本。

papers.title: Inferring gene regulatory networks from single-cell transcriptomics jointly through graph neural networks and Transformer.
papers.abstract: Inferring gene regulatory networks (GRNs) is crucial for understanding the complex regulatory relationships that govern gene expression in cells. Recently, several computational methods have been proposed for reconstructing GRNs from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data. However, most of these methods primarily focus on pairwise regulatory relationships between genes, failing to leverage the global regulatory structure of GRNs, which is crucial for exploring the complex regulatory interactions between transcription factors (TFs) and their target genes. To address these limitations, we propose GTGRNS, a supervised learning framework that integrates a graph neural network with a Transformer encoder for GRN inference from scRNA-seq data. Specifically, we utilize the GraphSAGE model to integrate regulatory network topological information with gene expression features, facilitating the learning of gene representations. By leveraging the Transformer model, we further extract complex dependencies of gene pairs, which are crucial for determining regulatory levels. The comparative experiments on several benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and competitiveness of the proposed GTGRNS in the task of GRN inference.
papers.venue: IEEE transactions on computational biology and bioinformatics

summary.takeaway: 提出 GTGRNS，将 GraphSAGE 与 Transformer 编码器结合，从 scRNA-seq 数据中同时利用基因表达特征与调控网络拓扑信息推断基因调控网络。
summary.methods: 监督学习框架：用 GraphSAGE 融合网络拓扑与表达特征学习基因表示，再用 Transformer 提取基因对之间的复杂依赖以判定调控关系；在多个基准数据集上做比较实验。
summary.relevance: 直接对应 GRN/Regulon 推断主题，强调超越成对关系、利用全局调控结构。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体数据集名称、评价指标数值与消融结果，也未说明对稀疏或噪声 scRNA-seq 数据的稳健性。

papers.title: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B: Attributed Reinforcement Learning for Long-Term Memory Writing
papers.abstract: External-memory systems extend language-model applications beyond a context window, but their quality depends critically on the model executing the write path: deciding what to retain, how precisely to represent it, and how new evidence should update persistent state. Existing frameworks typically place a general-purpose large language model behind framework-specific prompts. This raises serving cost, and a writer specialized for one protocol does not transfer directly to another; a unified model that can operate across established memory frameworks remains largely unexplored. We present Hy-Memory-30B-A3B, a compact long-term-memory writer trained across Mem0, MemOS, and Hy-Memory. Memory On-Policy Distillation teaches framework-specific write protocols on student-generated states; Memory RL then optimizes downstream answerability using dense per-chunk probes, attributed cross-chunk rewards, over-storage controls, and chunk-level GRPO. Carrying policy-written banks across windows keeps training aligned with deployment. On fixed 20% benchmark subsamples, Hy-Memory-30B-A3B ranks first on all four evaluated harnesses, including held-out EverMemOS, with a 55.49% macro average versus 54.62% for Claude Opus 5.

summary.takeaway: 提出面向长期记忆写入的紧凑模型 Hy-Memory-30B-A3B，跨 Mem0、MemOS、Hy-Memory 等框架训练，统一执行记忆写入策略。
summary.methods: 先以 Memory On-Policy Distillation 在学生生成状态上学习各框架写入协议，再用 Memory RL 结合逐块探针、跨块归因奖励、过度存储控制和 chunk 级 GRPO 优化下游可答性。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型外部记忆、检索增强与强化学习，关注“写什么、如何表示、如何更新”的记忆写入路径。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告固定 20% 基准子样本上的排名与宏平均，未给出完整评测规模与统计细节；跨框架迁移能力需原文验证。

papers.title: All-in-One Memory: Process-Rewarded Reinforcement Learning for Memory Agents
papers.abstract: Large language models increasingly rely on external memory to answer queries grounded in long-horizon histories such as multi-session dialogues and lengthy documents. However, existing memory methods often optimize retrieval and memory construction separately, without a shared reward space for evaluating search, writing, and stopping decisions. To address this, we propose All-in-One Memory (AiO-Mem), which organizes these operations as transitions over a shared evidence state and directly evaluates the semantic quality of each action in a unified reward space. AiO-Mem compiles heterogeneous histories into source-traceable multi-view events, providing a shared substrate for retrieval and memory writing. A unified memory policy actor then rolls out complete interaction trajectories over this shared evidence state. A separate trajectory-conditioned process reward model is trained through evidence-grounded supervised fine-tuning and trajectory-level DPO to assign process scores to the collected trajectories. These scores are aggregated into an action-balanced trajectory reward and used by Process-Aligned DAPO (PA-DAPO) to optimize the memory policy. Across long-context memory benchmarks, AiO-Mem consistently improves answer accuracy over both static memory systems and RL-trained memory agents.

summary.takeaway: 提出 All-in-One Memory (AiO-Mem)，在共享证据状态上统一建模检索、写入与停止决策，并用过程奖励强化学习优化记忆智能体。
summary.methods: 将异构历史编译为可溯源多视图事件；统一记忆策略在共享证据状态上展开轨迹；训练轨迹条件过程奖励模型（证据监督微调与轨迹级 DPO），聚合为动作均衡奖励，再用 Process-Aligned DAPO 优化策略。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型长期记忆与检索增强，并将强化学习用于记忆智能体的过程决策。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称在长上下文记忆基准上一致提升准确率，未列出具体基准、基线数值与训练成本。

papers.title: Routing Policy Optimization for Online Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning can align visual generators with reward signals beyond their pretraining objectives, but existing score-function methods typically introduce stochasticity by perturbing the reverse denoising trajectory, leading to costly rollout-based optimization. We instead ask whether stochastic exploration can be introduced inside the generator while preserving its original sampler. Routing Policy Optimization (RPO) answers this question by turning attention routing into a stochastic exploration action. At a few selected denoising levels, each query block keeps its own block and samples further key blocks in proportion to the generator's native attention mass, or keeps dense attention. The sampled route perturbs the velocity of that transition, and a Gaussian likelihood around the dense velocity scores the perturbation with a score-function objective. RPO further uses a controlled two-rollout estimator: two rollouts share the same prompt, initial latent, routed denoising levels, and dense anchor layers, differing only in their sampled attention routes. Their reward difference provides an advantage signal for the routed transitions. Because the likelihood differentiates the dense velocity itself, the learned updates remain effective after routing is removed. At inference, RPO restores dense attention and retains the original deterministic sampler. Experiments on text-to-image and text-to-video generation show that RPO improves generation quality while achieving nearly 4x higher training efficiency than Flow-GRPO-style methods. Please see our project page at https://velox-world.com/rpo for visual results.

summary.takeaway: 提出 Routing Policy Optimization (RPO)，把注意力路由作为随机探索动作，在保留原采样器的同时用强化学习对齐扩散生成器。
summary.methods: 在若干去噪层对 query 块按原生注意力质量采样 key 块或保留稠密注意力；用稠密速度周围的高斯似然构造 score-function 目标，并采用共享提示、初始隐变量和路由层的双 rollout 估计优势。
summary.relevance: 涉及扩散模型的强化学习对齐与训练效率，与强化学习主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要中的效率与质量提升主要针对 Flow-GRPO 类方法比较，未说明奖励模型设计、计算开销细节及对多种扩散架构的适用性。

papers.title: RAG-RST: Retrieved Exemplars as In-Context Discourse Schema for RST Parsing
papers.abstract: In Rhetorical Structure Theory (RST), each edge of a discourse tree carries a nuclearity label, marking which span holds the central content, and a relation drawn from a closed inventory of functional categories. Neither label is a surface property: the same two clauses can be Elaboration or Background depending on rhetorical intent, and the boundary between them is fixed by annotation convention rather than by lexical cues. Predicting these labels therefore requires a formal discourse schema, and exposure to discourse-rich pretraining text does not supply it: given only a target EDU pair, a strong LLM recovers nuclearity at 0.794 F1 and relation at 0.738 F1. We propose RAG-RST, a retrieval-augmented framework that supplies this schema as in-context demonstration rather than through parameter updates, raising nuclearity to 0.846 F1 and relation to 0.788 F1 with no training. Two configurations are compared: a precomputed strategy that labels all EDU pairs before parsing, and a dynamic strategy that retrieves at each reduce step, so that the exemplars reaching the generator depend on the reductions the parser has already committed to. Both outperform existing RST parsers across span, nuclearity, relation, and full tree metrics, with the dynamic variant consistently strongest. Two properties of the retrieved schema emerge: its utility is bounded in number, saturating and then declining beyond fifty exemplars, and it depends on structural position. Both indicate that a formal linguistic schema can be supplied to a foundation model as a demonstration rather than trained into its parameters.

summary.takeaway: 提出 RAG-RST，将检索到的示例作为上下文中的篇章图式，在不训练参数的情况下提升 RST 解析的核性、关系与整树指标。
summary.methods: 比较预计算策略与在每次归约步骤动态检索示例的两种配置；用检索示例作为 in-context demonstration 提供给生成器。
summary.relevance: 属于检索增强与篇章结构解析交叉方向，说明形式化语言图式可通过上下文示例而非参数更新注入基础模型。
summary.caveat: 摘要显示示例效用存在数量饱和并在超过 50 个后下降，且依赖结构位置；未说明检索器质量与跨语料泛化。

papers.title: TEM: Temporal State Tracking Memory for Large Language Model Agents
papers.abstract: An agent's memory must remain useful as information changes across conversations. A new fact may replace an earlier value without making that value irrelevant to a later question. We present Temporal State Tracking Memory (TEM), a training-free framework for tracking these changes. TEM stores facts as versioned records linked to their sources. It retrieves relevant versions, places them in source order and labels historical records before passing the evidence to the answer model. Event memory and original dialogue turns provide details missing from structured facts. We evaluated TEM on 420 questions drawn from 600 sessions involving 60 personas. Across four open-weight models, key-entity hit rates reached 75.71-97.62% overall and 96.67-100.00% on the historical-residence subset. Adding historical labels to otherwise identical, source-ordered facts increased overall hit rates by 17.14-55.95 percentage points. The evidence was compact: 94-118 tokens per answer, or 48.75-56.73% less than session-aware retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). A further evaluation on 1,540 LoCoMo questions tested hybrid memory under a fixed evidence budget. TEM exceeded session-aware RAG with both backbones; conservative score differences were 7.92 and 10.58 percentage points. The results support preserving fact versions and exposing their temporal status to the generator when answering questions about repeatedly updated information.

summary.takeaway: 提出无需训练的 Temporal State Tracking Memory (TEM)，将事实存为带来源的版本化记录，按来源顺序检索并标注历史状态，帮助模型回答信息随时间更新的问题。
summary.methods: 版本化事实记录加事件记忆与原始对话轮次；检索相关版本并标注历史记录后交给答案模型；在 420 个问题及 LoCoMo 1,540 个问题上评测。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型智能体长期记忆与检索增强，强调时间变化下的事实版本保留。
summary.caveat: 摘要中的提升来自特定构造的问题集与固定证据预算设置，未充分说明多跳推理、冲突消解和真实部署场景下的表现。

papers.title: L2GSSL: Label-Efficient Local-to-Global Self-Supervised Learning for Volumetric Healthcare Data
papers.abstract: Healthcare institutions routinely accumulate high-dimensional computed tomography (CT) volumes, but only a fraction can be annotated by experts. We present L2GSSL, a local-to-global self-supervised learning framework that leverages unlabeled volumes by decomposing pretraining into intra-slice and inter-slice representation spaces. A slice encoder learns view-invariant local features, and a global encoder aggregates the resulting tokens to model volumetric context. The stop-gradient isolates the local space from the global objective, while slice-wise execution and a three-phase schedule support training under constrained GPU memory. On LIDC-IDRI lung nodule malignancy classification, L2GSSL reaches $0.9229$ AUROC with only $10\%$ of the labels and $0.9377$ with $25\%$, exceeding the volume-level VICReg by $0.0229$ and $0.0294$, respectively. With all labels, the strongest supervised baseline exceeds L2GSSL by only $0.0044$ AUROC, consistent with self-supervised pretraining providing its greatest value when annotations are limited. Without adaptation to the external LNDb cohort, a model fine-tuned on $25\%$ of LIDC-IDRI obtains $0.8138$ AUROC and $0.7589$ AUPRC, improving over the strongest evaluated self-supervised baseline by $0.1130$ and $0.0954$. Experiments across data sources, thoracic and abdominal anatomy, downstream tasks, and two backbones examine healthcare-data variety, while lesion-slice masking shows that the predictions depend on lesion-bearing content.

summary.takeaway: 提出L2GSSL，一种从局部到全局的自监督预训练框架，用于利用未标注的CT体数据，在标注稀缺时提升肺结节恶性分类性能。
summary.methods: 将预训练分解为层内与层间表示空间：切片编码器学习视图不变的局部特征，全局编码器聚合token建模体上下文；使用stop-gradient隔离局部空间，切片式执行与三阶段调度降低显存需求。在LIDC-IDRI上评估，并测试LNDb外部队列、胸腹部解剖、两类backbone及病灶切片掩码。
summary.relevance: 属于自监督与表示学习及预训练方向；其标签高效设定和局部-全局分解与单细胞/医学基础模型中的预训练表示学习思路相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告与其他自监督方法在全部标签下的对比细节；外部泛化仅在无适配条件下评估，跨队列表现仍有下降。

papers.title: From Closed-Set Annotation to In-Context Discovery: Biologically Grounded LLMs for Cellular Profiling
papers.abstract: Tumour heterogeneity reflects both cellular identity (lineage) and state (active transcriptional programs), yet computational methods generally analyse these axes separately. We introduce CellScribe, a generative framework that conditions a pretrained language model on frozen single cell foundation model embeddings through AdaLN adapters, enabling one shared model to generate an ontology- grounded cell type or a quantified meta-program profile. Supervised multitask fine- tuning produces fine grained typing across hundreds of cell types and outperforms generative and retrieval baselines on meta-program identification under study-holdout evaluation. We further train the model with reinforcement learning, scoring its generations against cell ontology distance and meta-program agreement, so that they align with biological knowledge rather than token agreement. To identify new cell types not present in the supervised training data, we post-train the model to read several labelled example cells in a single context, each conditioning its own text span, and infer the type of a query cell through in-context learning. CellScribe thus unifies cell identity and state in one generative interface, grounds both in biological structure, and identifies cell types outside the supervised vocabulary.

summary.takeaway: 提出CellScribe生成式框架，用预训练语言模型统一生成本体约束的细胞类型或量化meta-program谱，并可通过上下文学习识别监督词表外的新细胞类型。
summary.methods: 以冻结的单细胞基础模型嵌入为条件，经AdaLN适配器注入预训练语言模型；先做监督多任务微调实现数百种细胞类型细粒度注释与meta-program识别，再用强化学习按细胞本体距离和meta-program一致性打分；最后后训练模型在上下文中读取若干带标签示例细胞以推断查询细胞类型。
summary.relevance: 直接对应Cell Foundation Model、预训练与强化学习主题，并涉及单细胞身份与状态的统一建模。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体性能数值、所用数据集规模及强化学习奖励设计的消融结果；在真实新细胞类型发现中的可靠性尚需验证。

papers.title: Learning to Think and Explore in 3D World
papers.abstract: We study how vision-language models (VLMs) can learn to think and actively explore in 3D space. Instead of providing multi-view images, videos, or 3D representations to the model, we preserve the native visual encoding of VLMs, i.e., a single image, one at a time, just like humans, and treat the 3D representation only as an environment with which the model can interact through actions (e.g., move left) and observations (rendered images). Each rollout begins from an initial first-person view and a visual question. The model can then iteratively reason, navigate, and reorient its viewpoint before committing to a final answer. Following an initial trajectory-supervised finetuning, we apply reinforcement learning (RL) with rewards driven primarily by final-answer correctness. Crucially, RL provides no direct supervision over which viewpoints the model should visit or which exploration actions it should take. Instead, the model must learn an effective exploration policy solely from the extent to which its interactions improve performance. Across six 3D benchmarks, our model ACT3D achieves an average accuracy of 53.2% that improves its base Qwen model by 22.0% and surpasses proprietary Gemini 3.6 Flash. ACT3D also outperforms existing open-source 3D methods while using 50-70% fewer input frames, and generalizes to unseen domains with an average improvement of 5.9% over its supervised initialization. Further analysis reveals adaptive, question-conditioned exploration. Performance gains over the base model increase from 0.6% on questions answerable from the initial view to 16.3% on those requiring extensive exploration. ACT3D searches for occluded targets, avoids unnecessary exploration, and acquires complementary viewpoints for spatial comparisons. These findings demonstrate that outcome-based RL enables VLMs not only to reason over visual evidence, but also to learn when and how to acquire it.

summary.takeaway: 提出ACT3D，让视觉语言模型以单帧第一视角图像为输入，通过动作与环境交互主动探索3D空间，并仅凭最终答案正确性奖励学习探索策略。
summary.methods: 在轨迹监督微调后使用强化学习，奖励主要来自最终答案正确性，不直接监督视角选择或探索动作；在六个3D基准上评估，并与基座Qwen模型、Gemini 3.6 Flash及开源3D方法比较，分析问题条件化探索行为。
summary.relevance: 属于强化学习与多模态学习/跨模态理解方向，展示结果驱动强化学习如何训练模型主动获取视觉证据。
summary.caveat: 摘要性能数字为原文报告，未说明强化学习训练稳定性、样本效率及在真实机器人环境中的迁移能力；探索策略的可解释性仅来自行为分析。

papers.title: DocPilot: Interactive Agent Orchestration and Training for Long Visual Document Understanding
papers.abstract: Multimodal long-document question answering requires models to seek sparse evidence across pages and modalities, understand heterogeneous document content, and reason over the collected evidence. Even advanced vision-language models (VLMs) can overlook sparse evidence and struggle with cross-modal reasoning in a single pass. Existing document agents further introduce multi-step interaction, but some still rely on predefined workflows or coarse-grained actions, limiting the flexibility and granularity of document reasoning. We introduce DocPilot, an agentic document framework that supports expressive orchestration and makes complex document solving learnable by small language models (SLMs). DocPilot orchestrates evidence seeking through page-level navigation and fine-grained evidence localization, and integrates local visual inspection, code-based numerical reasoning, and cross-modal reasoning for multimodal understanding. To transfer these capabilities to small models, we propose curriculum-based agentic training that progresses from single-ability learning to adaptive orchestration through supervision from data-grounded reasoning traces and executable interaction trajectories. Across MMLongBench-Doc, DocBench, FinRAGBench-V, and MADQA, DocPilot achieves strong gains with frontier VLM backbones, while DocPilot-4B delivers competitive performance against substantially larger models, demonstrating strong effectiveness and generalization across diverse long-document reasoning settings. The code is available at https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DocPilot.

summary.takeaway: 提出DocPilot，一种可交互编排的文档智能体框架，通过页面级导航与细粒度证据定位支持长视觉文档问答，并用课程式智能体训练使小模型具备复杂文档求解能力。
summary.methods: 编排证据检索，包括页面导航、细粒度证据定位，并整合局部视觉检查、代码数值推理与跨模态推理；采用从单能力学习到自适应编排的课程式训练，监督信号来自数据 grounded 的推理轨迹与可执行交互轨迹；在MMLongBench-Doc、DocBench、FinRAGBench-V、MADQA上评估，并训练DocPilot-4B。
summary.relevance: 对应检索增强与对齐、多模态学习及跨模态理解与生成，尤其是长文档中的稀疏证据检索与智能体编排。
summary.caveat: 摘要未披露各基准的具体分数与消融细节；小模型竞争力主要相对更大模型描述，训练数据构造与可执行轨迹的获取成本未说明。

papers.title: Emerging frontiers for AI in single-cell genomics.
papers.abstract: We are just over a decade into the single-cell revolution in biology, which has been coupled to the growing use of artificial intelligence (AI) in single-cell genomics. Most early single-cell RNA embedding models and subsequent "foundation models"-representational models pretrained on large single-cell datasets-did not gain wide traction among experimental biologists. However, as massive single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) atlas efforts ramp up, there is a clear rationale for exploiting AI models to interpret new datasets in the context of vast existing data resources. Meanwhile, the advent of single-cell epigenetic/multiomic assays and Perturb-seq technologies presents new opportunities for AI modeling. Here, we review AI embedding and foundation models for scRNA-seq and single-cell assay for transposase-accessible chromatin using sequencing (scATAC-seq), extensive machine-learning efforts to exploit single-cell multiome in regulatory genomics, and AI strategies to learn "virtual cell" models from Perturb-seq, ending with a description of current limitations of single-cell AI models and an outlook for future advances.

summary.takeaway: 综述AI在单细胞基因组学中的新兴前沿，涵盖scRNA-seq与scATAC-seq的嵌入和基础模型、单细胞多组学调控基因组学机器学习以及从Perturb-seq学习虚拟细胞模型。
summary.methods: 综述性文章，梳理单细胞RNA嵌入模型与基础模型、scATAC-seq建模、多组学调控基因组学方法及Perturb-seq虚拟细胞策略，并讨论当前局限与未来方向。
summary.relevance: 直接对应单细胞扰动、虚拟细胞与预训练主题，为细胞基础模型和扰动建模提供领域路线图。
summary.caveat: 作为综述，摘要未提供新的实验数值或因果结论；对具体模型优劣的判断需参考正文证据。

papers.title: Ranking and Partitioning of Attention Heads for Sparse and Continual Reinforcement Learning Fine-tuning
papers.abstract: We study sparse and continual reinforcement learning fine-tuning of language models through attention-head ranking and partitioning. For sparse learning, we rank attention heads by gradient norm to identify a small subset of heads that can be trained effectively. For continual learning, we partition heads across tasks to reduce cross-task interference and preserve previously learned capabilities. Theoretically, we relate gradient norm to training effectiveness, and further characterize why sparse, separated head updates can remain stable. Empirically, across math, instruction-following, and coding tasks, tuning higher-ranked heads consistently outperforms tuning lower-ranked ones while often matching denser baselines, and head partitioning improves retention while preserving adaptation to new tasks.

summary.takeaway: 研究按梯度范数对注意力头排序与分区，以实现语言模型的稀疏与持续强化学习微调，兼顾训练有效性与跨任务知识保留。
summary.methods: 按梯度范数排序注意力头并只训练高排名子集以进行稀疏学习；持续学习中将头分配给不同任务以减少干扰。理论分析梯度范数与训练效果及稀疏分离更新的稳定性，并在数学、指令遵循和编码任务上实验。
summary.relevance: 对应强化学习与持续学习主题，为参数高效微调与缓解灾难性遗忘提供注意力头层面的策略。
summary.caveat: 摘要只给出相对结论，未报告具体任务分数、头选择比例的敏感性或大规模模型上的验证；理论结论依赖的假设未在摘要中展开。

papers.title: X-Fly: Learning to Reach and Stop in Full-Chunk Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Aerial vision-language navigation (VLN) agents built on large vision-language models are expensive to query. Executing a complete predicted action chunk before replanning amortizes this cost, reducing model inference from 195 to 42 ms per executed waypoint for our policy. It also moves the states at which the policy is queried away from expert demonstrations, which supervise neither recovery from these states nor termination at the learner's own arrival. On OpenFly test-seen, no-stop failures account for 47.78% of full-chunk behavior cloning (BC) outcomes. We present X-Fly, a staged training framework for full-chunk aerial VLN. Recovery DAgger labels learner-visited decision states with smooth chunks that reconnect to future expert segments and with STOP at the first in-region state. Flow-GRPO then jointly refines the chunked flow controller and a Bernoulli STOP policy from same-task closed-loop outcomes, supplemented by outcome-verified stopping supervision. With eight controls per decision, X-Fly reaches 74.18% SR on test-seen and 51.73% on test-unseen, compared with 16.45% and 18.43% for full-chunk BC and 32.04% and 29.46% for DreamFly.

summary.takeaway: 提出X-Fly，面向全动作块空中视觉语言导航的分阶段训练框架，解决整块执行带来的恢复与自主停止问题，显著提升成功率。
summary.methods: 先执行完整预测动作块再重规划以摊薄大模型查询成本；采用Recovery DAgger对学习者访问状态标注可重连专家未来段的光滑动作块并在首个区域内状态标注STOP；再用Flow-GRPO从同任务闭环结果联合优化分块流控制器与Bernoulli STOP策略，并加入结果验证的停止监督。在OpenFly test-seen/test-unseen评估。
summary.relevance: 属于多模态学习与跨模态理解与生成，涉及视觉语言模型在具身导航中的动作生成与停止决策。
summary.caveat: 结果限于仿真基准OpenFly，未说明真实飞行器部署；STOP策略与流控制器的联合优化稳定性及训练成本未在摘要中详述。

papers.title: Private Retrieval Augmented Generation via Random Projection
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by querying external structured knowledge. However, it can also introduce privacy risks by leaking sensitive information from the retrieval datastore. We propose a simple method to preserve datastore privacy in RAG systems via random projection. By applying the same projection to both datastore embeddings and query embeddings, our method provably preserves semantic similarity between queries and retrieved items while substantially mitigating data extraction attacks. Across multiple RAG architectures and datasets, we show that this lightweight approach achieves superior retrieval and generation performance compared to prior methods which leverage formal differential privacy (DP) guarantees, while exhibiting comparable empirical privacy under strong attack models. Our results for the first time suggest that random projection can serve as a competitive and practical baseline for privacy-preserving RAG systems.

summary.takeaway: 提出通过随机投影保护RAG数据存储隐私的轻量方法，在保持查询与检索项语义相似性的同时缓解数据抽取攻击。
summary.methods: 对数据存储嵌入与查询嵌入施加同一随机投影；在多种RAG架构和数据集上比较检索与生成性能，并与基于形式化差分隐私的方法在强攻击模型下的经验隐私进行对照。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型与检索增强与对齐主题，关注RAG系统的隐私风险与可用性权衡。
summary.caveat: 摘要称隐私性为经验可比而非形式化DP保证；未列出具体攻击类型、数据集及隐私-效用权衡的数值细节，理论保证仅覆盖语义相似性保持。

papers.title: Reliable Knowledge Acquisition for Continual Learning Agents
papers.abstract: As agents powered by foundation models move into open-ended environments, continual learning from experience becomes essential. For agents built on models with fixed parameters, this learning requires reusing prior task experience in context to improve performance and efficiency on future tasks. Existing memory and experience-learning systems typically focus on either retained facts or procedures, and lack a mechanism for establishing the reliability of claims extracted from the ongoing task stream. Indeed, we find that approximately 12--33\% of entries produced by representative systems harm future task performance when reused. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{RIKA} (Reliable Knowledge Acquisition), which combines hierarchical extraction of factual, conceptual, procedural, and metacognitive knowledge with Evidence-based Knowledge Admission, which uses source evidence and subsequent experience to govern which claims enter the task agent's context, without additional validation tasks. Across six task streams from Continual Learning Bench and four model backbones, RIKA achieves the highest aggregate score on every backbone.

summary.takeaway: 提出RIKA，将事实、概念、程序与元认知知识的分层抽取与基于证据的知识准入结合，以提高从任务流中获取知识并复用于后续任务时的可靠性。
summary.methods: 在Continual Learning Bench的六个任务流和四种模型骨干上评估，使用证据来源和后续经验决定哪些主张进入智能体上下文，无需额外验证任务。
summary.relevance: 直接针对持续学习与预训练模型智能体，关注在固定参数模型上通过上下文复用经验提高未来任务表现。
summary.caveat: 摘要只说明约12–33%的条目由代表性系统产生时会损害后续表现，并报告聚合得分最高；未给出各任务流和骨干的详细数值及消融结果。

papers.title: DNA-LLM2Vec: Architecture-Aware Task-Conditioned Adaptation of Decoder DNA Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Decoder DNA foundation models pretrain with dense next-token prediction and scale to long sequences, but their representations are directional. This is a poor fit for genomic tasks that need sequence context both upstream and downstream of a locus. Bidirectional masked-language-model encoders supply this context, but they pretrain more sparsely and scale less easily to long windows. We introduce DNA-LLM2Vec, a staged decoder-to-encoder framework that opens bidirectional context, repairs the resulting mismatch with masked next-token prediction, and applies contrastive views encoding strand and positional invariance. We instantiate it on two architecturally distinct backbones, DNAGPT and HyenaDNA, and evaluate seven biological task families (grouped from GB, NT, GUE, and GUE+EPI) with frozen linear probing. The benefits of conversion are architecture-aware and task-conditioned rather than uniform. Crop-based positional contrastive learning helps most for the extended-context families (enhancer-promoter interaction and Virus-COVID), raising frozen Avg-EPI MCC to 27.5% for DNAGPT and 26.7% for HyenaDNA, whereas for shorter, local families the results depend on backbone and tokenisation. Beyond classification, bidirectional context and MNTP improve causal-eQTL variant-effect prediction specifically at distance, and a base-pair mutagenesis diagnostic shows that adaptation organises motif-aware contact structure while reverse-complement training imprints strand-consistent geometry, yet neither predicts the best downstream view. DNA-LLM2Vec therefore produces frozen bidirectional representations whose most effective adaptation view depends on the task structure and the backbone. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/semi-nothing/dna-llm2vec.

summary.takeaway: 提出DNA-LLM2Vec，将解码器DNA基础模型分阶段转换为具有双向上下文的编码器表示，并指出转换收益依赖架构与任务。
summary.methods: 在DNAGPT和HyenaDNA两个骨干上实例化，采用掩码下一词预测修复不匹配，并引入编码链与位置不变性的对比视图；在GB、NT、GUE和GUE+EPI分组的七个生物任务族上用冻结线性探针评估。
summary.relevance: 面向预训练与自监督表示学习，探索解码器DNA基础模型在基因组双向上下文任务中的适配。
summary.caveat: 摘要明确指出收益并非一致，短局部任务族的结果依赖骨干和分词；还提到最佳下游视图不能由诊断指标预测，且评估主要基于冻结线性探针。

papers.title: BitSparse: Compact Activation Storage for ReLU Feed-Forward Networks
papers.abstract: Reducing memory use in large language model (LLM) training is an ongoing challenge. Activation checkpointing saves memory by recomputation, while lossy compression changes the stored activations. The reemergence of sparse $\relu$ and $\relu^2$ activations creates a third opportunity: losslessly compressing the activation cache itself. We present BitSparse, a GPU-resident lossless compression format for sparse activations. Compression and reconstruction run in custom Triton kernels fused into an autograd function, shrinking the activation cache while recovering it exactly for the backward pass. Bfloat16 (BF16) and FP8 activations are supported. Optional sign-bit packing further increases compression up to close to the theoretical limit. We analyze its compression ratio and compare it to the theoretical optimum. BitSparse lowers per-token VRAM by 31\% and 30\% Modded-NanoGPT and Nemotron-H respectively, with overheads of no more than 1\% at practical sequence lengths. Additionally, a new preallocated buffer system avoids host synchronization during training when variable size tensors are allocated.

summary.takeaway: 提出BitSparse，一种GPU驻留的稀疏激活无损压缩格式，用于在LLM训练中缩小激活缓存并精确恢复以支持反向传播。
summary.methods: 针对稀疏ReLU和ReLU²激活，使用融合进autograd函数的自定义Triton内核执行压缩与重建，支持BF16与FP8激活，可选符号位打包，并引入预分配缓冲区系统。
summary.relevance: 与大语言模型训练内存优化相关；摘要标注主题为检索增强与对齐，但内容实际聚焦训练效率而非检索或对齐。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告在Modded-NanoGPT和Nemotron-H上每token显存分别降低31%和30%，实际序列长度下开销不超过1%；但未给出与其他压缩或检查点方法的系统对比细节。

papers.title: OntoAct: Hypothesis-Based Neuro-Symbolic Agents through Ontological Abstraction
papers.abstract: Learning from experience requires recovering reusable knowledge and determining when it applies to a new situation. We introduce OntoAct, a hypothesis-based neuro-symbolic framework built on ontological abstraction. OntoAct turns individual experiences into axioms over entity types, relations, and conditions, making their underlying patterns reusable across situations. A large language model (LLM) uses this world knowledge to propose hypotheses and actions, while a symbolic verifier assesses their supporting conditions against current observations. Verification identifies missing evidence, and new observations and intervention outcomes update hypothesis assessments and guide subsequent actions. We also introduce Tacit-FLE, a benchmark built on the Factorio Learning Environment (FLE) for diagnosing and repairing hidden faults in existing factories using inherited operational records. Its synthetic maintenance corpus distributes evidence across records, and an executed repair may leave the fault unresolved, requiring agents to reassess their diagnoses through interaction. Across Tacit-FLE, Mars, and ALFWorld, OntoAct achieves leading task performance with efficient interaction and inference.

summary.takeaway: 提出OntoAct，一个基于本体抽象和假设的神经符号框架，将经验转化为关于实体类型、关系和条件的公理，以便跨情境复用知识与验证假设。
summary.methods: LLM提出假设与动作，符号验证器对照当前观测检查支撑条件；新观测和干预结果更新假设评估。还提出基于Factorio Learning Environment的Tacit-FLE基准，用于诊断和修复现有工厂中的隐藏故障。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型智能体、知识表示与图谱式抽象，关注从经验中恢复可复用知识并判断适用条件。
summary.caveat: 摘要称在Tacit-FLE、Mars和ALFWorld上取得领先任务表现且交互和推理高效，但未提供具体数值、基线细节或失败案例分析。

papers.title: OmniScore: Universal Scoring of Diverse Biomolecular Complexes via Equivariant Geometry-Aware Discrete Representation Learning
papers.abstract: Biomolecular structures provide a common physical basis for understanding molecular function and interactions. However, computational models typically specialize in individual molecular classes or tasks, hindering a unified representation of structural information across biological systems. Here we introduce OmniScore, a universal geometric encoder that learns shared representations of proteins, nucleic acids, small molecules and their complexes. Pretraining integrates geometric graph encoding, sequential modeling and tokenization with structural and physicochemical supervision. The frozen pretrained encoder supports complex-level model quality assessment and interaction prediction, as well as residue-level prediction, through task-specific heads. OmniScore outperforms the evaluated antibody--antigen quality-assessment baselines and also improves RNA structure ranking over baselines. For peptide-major histocompatibility complex interaction prediction, the OmniScore embeddings complement structure-prediction confidence metrics to improve predictive performance. Together, these findings support OmniScore as a shared geometric foundation for biomolecular representation and scoring across molecular classes and prediction scales, which may facilitate multi-component therapeutics development.

summary.takeaway: 提出OmniScore，一个面向蛋白质、核酸、小分子及其复合物的通用几何编码器，学习跨分子类别的共享结构表示并支持多种评分与预测任务。
summary.methods: 预训练整合几何图编码、序列建模、分词以及结构和物理化学监督；冻结预训练编码器加任务特定头，用于复合物模型质量评估、相互作用预测和残基级预测。
summary.relevance: 直接对应预训练与自监督表示学习，强调跨分子类别的统一几何基础表示。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称在抗体-抗原质量评估和RNA结构排序上优于所评估基线，在肽-MHC相互作用预测中嵌入可补充结构预测置信度；未给出具体指标、数据规模或跨任务泛化限制。

papers.title: CARA: Causally Guided Retrieval Agent for Question Answering
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation over text-rich knowledge graphs requires identifying evidence that contributes to answering a question, rather than merely matching its textual content. Existing agentic retrievers adaptively balance global search and multi-hop exploration but primarily rely on textual similarity to guide retrieval. We propose CARA, a training-free, CAusally guided Retrieval Agent that explicitly evaluates the causal relevance of retrieved evidence through two complementary criteria: consequentiality, measuring whether adding evidence improves answerability, and essentiality, assessing whether removing evidence weakens answerability. CARA integrates these assessments with path consistency to guide graph exploration and employs reciprocal rank fusion to aggregate evidence from multiple agents. We evaluate CARA on three STaRK datasets and augment STaRK with ground-truth answers to enable downstream question answering evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that CARA consistently outperforms existing retrievers. CARA also improves answer quality and faithfulness while examining fewer graph nodes and requiring fewer retrieval operations. These findings demonstrate that causal relevance assessment enables more focused and effective agentic graph retrieval, improving both retrieval performance and downstream question answering.

summary.takeaway: 提出CARA，一个免训练的因果引导检索智能体，通过评估证据的后果性与必要性来指导文本丰富知识图上的检索。
summary.methods: 用后果性衡量加入证据是否提升可回答性，用必要性衡量移除证据是否削弱可回答性，并结合路径一致性和倒数排名融合聚合多个智能体的证据；在三个STaRK数据集上评估，并扩展STaRK以支持下游问答评估。
summary.relevance: 直接对应检索增强与知识图谱，关注超越文本相似度的因果相关证据检索。
summary.caveat: 摘要称CARA一致优于现有检索器并提升答案质量与忠实度，同时检查更少图节点和检索操作；未报告具体数值、统计显著性或在STaRK之外数据集的表现。

papers.title: Revealing pan-cancer clonal niches of T cells from single-cell RNA sequencing using contrastive learning
papers.abstract: T-cell clonal organization is central to anti-tumor immunity, yet its functional characterization typically requires paired single-cell RNA and TCR sequencing (scRNA/TCR-seq). Existing multimodal methods integrate transcriptome and TCR information but are limited when TCR data are unavailable. Here we present CloneTrast, a supervised contrastive-learning framework that uses paired scRNA/TCR-seq during training to learn clonal-functional states from gene expression, while requiring only scRNA-seq at inference. Using paired scRNA/TCR-seq profiles from 2.6 million human T cells across 16 cancer types, CloneTrast identified distinct T-cell clonal niches not explained solely by TCR sequence similarity or conventional cell-state annotations. Among these, an NK-like T-cell niche enriched for tumor-blood shared TCRs was consistently associated with poor immunotherapy response at the pan-cancer level. Analysis of antigen-specific T-cell clones revealed that tumor-resident and blood-borne antigen-specific T cells were preferentially associated with distinct clonal niches. Overall, CloneTrast enables scalable and interpretable inference of clonal organization from single-cell transcriptomes.

summary.takeaway: 提出CloneTrast，一个监督对比学习框架，训练时利用配对scRNA/TCR-seq学习克隆-功能状态，推理时仅需scRNA-seq即可推断T细胞克隆组织。
summary.methods: 使用16种癌症类型、约260万人类T细胞的配对scRNA/TCR-seq谱训练，在基因表达上学习克隆相关表示；分析克隆生态位、抗原特异性克隆及与免疫治疗反应的关联。
summary.relevance: 对应自监督与表示学习，展示对比学习在多模态单细胞数据中学习可迁移表示的应用。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告一个富含肿瘤-血液共享TCR的NK样T细胞生态位在泛癌层面与不良免疫治疗反应相关，但属于关联性发现；未说明前瞻验证、数据偏倚或推理时仅scRNA-seq的性能下降程度。

papers.title: Memorilla: Latent Semantic Memory for LLMs
papers.abstract: Memory enables large language models (LLMs) to use information beyond their parameters, such as past user conversations, long documents, or an agent's earlier actions. For a frozen LLM, access to this accumulated knowledge is limited to what a memory system places in its context window. However, gathering and combining relevant information needed for each query while keeping the model's context short remains challenging for existing systems. Here we introduce Memorilla, a memory system that gathers information from an entire document collection into a fixed number of query-dependent 'memory tokens' for a frozen LLM. Memorilla encodes documents (such as user chats, book chapters) once into reusable embeddings, then learns to retrieve and place query-specific information in the LLM's input embedding space. Using only 16 memory tokens, Memorilla achieves the best performance against baselines including Mem0 and MemoRAG on five of eight benchmarks spanning personalization, long-document and knowledge-intensive question answering. Notably, on FactKG, it reaches 84.33% accuracy versus 80.43% with full-context inference, while using 108x fewer tokens to represent the source documents. Furthermore, Memorilla can facilitate continual learning in agentic systems where the document count (the agent's past turns) increases throughout the trajectory. In a TextWorld environment, we show that Memorilla reduces the agent's tendency to wander between rooms it has already explored, and improves its average success rate from 18.6% with full-history in-context learning to 24.2%. Overall, Memorilla aids frozen LLMs in accumulating and using knowledge effectively across long-context interactions and takes a step towards building continually learning AI systems.

summary.takeaway: 提出Memorilla，一个面向冻结LLM的潜在语义记忆系统，将文档集合信息压缩为固定数量的查询相关记忆token，支持长上下文和智能体持续使用知识。
summary.methods: 先将文档编码为可复用嵌入，再学习检索并将查询特定信息放入LLM输入嵌入空间；使用16个记忆token，在八个基准上与人Mem0、MemoRAG等基线比较，并在TextWorld中评估智能体持续学习场景。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型、检索增强与持续学习，关注冻结模型如何跨长交互积累和使用外部知识。
summary.caveat: 摘要称在八个基准中的五个取得最佳表现，FactKG上84.33%对全上下文80.43%且表示源文档用少108倍token；TextWorld成功率从18.6%提升到24.2%。这些为摘要报告结果，未说明其他三个基准表现、记忆构建成本或泛化限制。

papers.title: PlantGeneAnn: a high-accuracy ab initio plant gene annotation tool fine-tuned from a genome foundation model
papers.abstract: Structural annotation remains a bottleneck for translating the growing catalog of high-quality plant genomes into biological insights, as current pipelines rely on RNA-seq and homologous protein evidence that are often unavailable for non-model species. Existing ab initio tools are constrained by model scale and perform poorly in complex plant genomic regions. We present PlantGeneAnn, a plant-optimized ab initio gene annotation tool fine-tuned from a genome foundation model. It combines a Mamba-MoE DNA encoder with a U-Net-style embedding decoder and a semi-Markov decoding pipeline. Trained on 40 angiosperm species, PlantGeneAnn establishes a new state-of-the-art (SOTA) across a stringent 20-species benchmark, significantly outperforming Helixer, Tiberius, and ANNEVO at exon-, intron-, and locus-levels, with mean F1 scores of 0.856, 0.880, and 0.707, respectively. It also enables efficient customized fine-tuning: LoRA fine-tuning increased the locus-level F1 of the out-of-distribution bryophyte Physcomitrium patens from 0.581 to 0.736, with performance plateauing at 40% of the fine-tuning data. Notably, PlantGeneAnn requires substantially lower peak memory usage than other baseline tools, allowing annotation of large plant genomes on standard personal workstations. PlantGeneAnn thus provides accurate, hardware-friendly ab initio annotation for diverse plant genomes, particularly newly assembled genomes, population-scale projects, and non-model plants.

summary.takeaway: 提出植物从头基因注释工具 PlantGeneAnn，基于基因组基础模型微调，在 20 物种基准上取得优于 Helixer、Tiberius 和 ANNEVO 的注释性能，并支持用 LoRA 进行低成本定制微调。
summary.methods: 采用 Mamba-MoE DNA 编码器、U-Net 式嵌入解码器和半马尔可夫解码流程；在 40 个被子植物物种上训练，并在 20 物种严格基准上评估 exon、intron 和 locus 级性能；对苔藓 Physcomitrium patens 进行 LoRA 微调实验。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于基因组基础模型的预训练与下游微调应用，展示了基础模型在植物基因注释任务上的迁移与适配方式。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明基准构建细节、训练与测试物种重叠情况以及各基线是否经过同等调优，因此 SOTA 结论的外部有效性仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Chemical foundation models reveal molecular principles underlying glycobiology
papers.abstract: Glycans encode biological specificity through branching, linkage and stereochemical diversity, and have traditionally been modelled using specialised computational representations distinct from those developed for general chemistry. It remains unclear to what extent representations learned from general molecular chemistry capture the molecular principles of glycobiology. Here, we systematically evaluate the transfer of chemical foundation models to glycobiology using standardized benchmarks spanning taxonomy, immunogenicity, glycosylation type and protein-glycan interactions. We show that atom-level representations learned from general chemistry encode biologically meaningful molecular organization, providing particularly strong performance for molecular recognition, including immunogenicity and protein-glycan interaction prediction. Fine-tuning reorganizes these representations into latent spaces aligned with glycan architecture, glycosylation programmes and molecular recognition. Mechanistic analyses identify stereochemistry as an important determinant of successful transfer, while tokenization, context length and conformer generation influence the representation of large, branched glycans. These representations generalize from natural glycans to synthetic glycomimetics and recover experimentally validated stereochemistry-dependent glycan-lectin recognition. Together, our findings demonstrate that molecular principles learned from general chemistry are sufficient to capture fundamental features of glycobiology. They position glycans as a specialised region of chemical space and chemical foundation models as a broadly applicable framework for glycan function prediction, molecular recognition and glycomimetic discovery.

summary.takeaway: 系统评估通用化学基础模型向糖生物学迁移的能力，发现原子级化学表示可编码有生物学意义的糖分子组织，微调会将其重组为与糖结构及分子识别对齐的潜空间。
summary.methods: 使用覆盖分类学、免疫原性、糖基化类型和蛋白-糖相互作用的标准化基准评估化学基础模型迁移；结合微调和机制分析，考察立体化学、tokenization、上下文长度与构象生成的影响。
summary.relevance: 该研究直接关联预训练表示在专业化学空间中的可迁移性，说明通用分子基础模型可用于糖功能预测和分子识别。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体性能数值或基准规模，且机制结论基于所选集基准，向其他糖类任务和更大分支糖链的泛化性尚不明确。

papers.title: Stimulus overlap confounds generalization in EEG foundation-model benchmarks
papers.abstract: Neural decoding benchmarks commonly evaluate generalization across participants while reusing the same experimental stimuli in training and test sets. This design cannot distinguish transfer to new stimuli from recognition of familiar material, a distinction that is increasingly important for electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models, pretrained models designed to learn reusable neural representations. Here we introduce a training-matched audit that varies stimulus overlap while holding test trials, training participants and stimulus counts fixed. Across ten tasks from seven EEG emotion datasets, stimulus overlap increased differential-entropy decoding accuracy in every task and accounted for 77% of above-chance seen-stimulus performance on FACED-9. Across representations, overlap-dependent gains tracked stimulus identifiability; for CBraMod and LaBraM, advantages over input-matched handcrafted features were concentrated on familiar stimuli. Architecture-matched random controls nevertheless showed transferable benefits of pretraining on unseen stimuli. These results separate participant generalization from stimulus generalization and provide a framework for evaluating both in neural decoding benchmarks.

summary.takeaway: 指出常见 EEG 解码基准混淆了跨被试泛化与刺激识别，并通过控制刺激重叠的审计证明刺激重叠会系统性抬高解码准确率。
summary.methods: 提出训练匹配审计，在固定测试试次、训练被试和刺激数量的条件下改变刺激重叠；在来自 7 个 EEG 情绪数据集的 10 个任务上评估，并比较 CBraMod、LaBraM、手工特征及架构匹配的随机对照。
summary.relevance: 该工作对 EEG 基础模型的预训练表示评估提出方法学警示，属于自监督与表示学习评测的重要反思。
summary.caveat: 摘要显示分析限于 EEG 情绪数据集和 differential-entropy 解码指标，结论能否推广到其他 EEG 范式和其他下游任务尚未说明。

papers.title: OpCredit: Operation-Aware Policy Learning for Agentic Knowledge Graph Question Answering
papers.abstract: Agentic knowledge graph question answering(KGQA) relies on sequences of executable operations, but trajectory-level rewards obscure their individual contributions. Successful trajectories may contain ineffective operations, while failed trajectories may contain useful ones.
